title: Canonical Evidence Foundation
rawUserRequest: 继续执行全面整改计划的 WI-01：建立 Canonical Evidence/Event 模型、事实源绑定和声明与证据校验基础。每个工单必须完成完整 PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和文档对齐流程；遇到流程问题先记录并修正。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

declaredIntent.summary: Create a single validated evidence/event boundary from which Summary, Outcome, Status, PR and release claims can be derived.

outOfScope: Task Outcome rendering and full Cockpit/PR integration (WI-09 and later)
Deleting historical plans or archive evidence (WI-17)

sources.reason: Defines WI-01 scope, canonical evidence acceptance and required post-work documentation alignment.
Defines evidence, event, claim, and derivation terminology.
Defines fail-closed Work Item and evidence lifecycle boundaries.
Existing structured evidence schema and digest conventions.
This Contract defines the bounded implementation and verification unit.

riskAssessment.reason: The boundary must reject missing, stale, conflicting and digest-mismatched evidence without rewriting historical records; later Work Items consume this contract.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly authorized serial execution after the plan Work Item was merged and closed; WI-01 has a bounded evidence/schema/test scope.

preReviewWarnings: Review canonical-source uniqueness, digest binding, stale/conflicting evidence, event ordering, privacy-safe facts, and derivation parity.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Canonical evidence/event schema binds each fact to an evidence ID, source, captured time, digest, subject and status; missing source or digest is rejected.
Evidence validation fails closed for missing, stale, conflicting, duplicate-source or digest-mismatched records and rejects claims without supporting evidence.
A deterministic JSON-to-Markdown derivation produces the same output from the same canonical payload and preserves event relationships without duplicate facts.
Focused schema/digest/event/derivation negative tests pass; required AI checks and `make quality` pass before the PR is opened.
The plan WI-01 section and glossary list the schema path, validator entry point, fail-closed rules and WI-02-or-later integration boundary used by this Work Item.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The repository has many structured evidence files and event records, but later outputs can still duplicate facts or claim readiness without one verifiable source binding. WI-01 establishes the canonical boundary that later unknown, installer, outcome and release work can consume.
constraints: Use JSON as the canonical machine representation and derive human-readable Markdown from it.
Do not rewrite historical event records or treat generated Markdown/PR/Status as independent sources of truth.
Use standard-library-only implementation and preserve fail-closed behavior for missing, stale, conflicting or digest-mismatched evidence.
intent.rationale: A small explicit schema and validator makes evidence identity and derivation testable before adding the later state, installer and reporting layers.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Valid canonical evidence with source, captured time and digest validates and renders deterministically
Missing source, digest mismatch, stale evidence and unsupported claim fail closed
Duplicate or conflicting facts are rejected rather than silently merged
The same canonical JSON deterministically derives equivalent Markdown and event relationships

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized full serial execution; approval is limited to the WI-01 canonical evidence schema path under .ai/schemas.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
